GitHub source is fully private.

Commits authored or committed from @payflows.io on public repos - 0 (search_commits)

Public GitHub Actions workflows exposing OIDC trust / cloud account IDs - no public repos, cannot inspect

pypi.payflows.io S3 bucket enumeration - origin bucket is 'payflows-pypi' in eu-west-1; ListObjectsV2/policy/acl/versioning all 403 AccessDenied, no s3-website config, no public index.html / robots.txt / simple/ / packages/ or any guessed package path (50+ probes, all NoSuchKey). Bucket name is leaked by standard S3 PermanentRedirect XML which is expected CloudFront+S3 behavior and not reportable on its own. Full probe log in raw/pypi/NOTES.md.

luigi-public-ws.payflows.io / luigi-api-public-ws.payflows.io direct WS compromise - both are AWS API Gateway WebSocket endpoints; only path '/' reaches the application; every WS Upgrade is intercepted by a Python Lambda authorizer that demands conversation_id (UUID) + token (JWT with kid-based JWKS lookup); 616 probes across 14 paths x 11 subprotocols produced zero 101 handshakes; see F001. No unauth data access, no introspection, no object-ID queries reachable. One low-sev info-disclosure logged (F001). Non-public counterparts luigi-ws / luigi-api-ws gate at the API Gateway itself with SigV4; no application reached.

open_threads.name: scim.payflows.io SCIM 2.0 enumeration
open_threads.why: SCIM endpoint returns 403 application/json. If GET /scim/v2/Users accepts a weak token or allows filter=userName sw, employee / customer-admin PII enumeration follows directly. High-severity PII and a feed for cross-tenant IDOR.

open_threads.name: payments-prod-docker-lambda.payflows.io / luigi-prod-docker-lambda.payflows.io
open_threads.why: Lambda container-image hosts (one 403, one 404). Confirm whether a Lambda Function URL / API Gateway sits in front; look for alternate verbs, trailing slash variants, .well-known, and common handler paths.

open_threads.name: Unleash + ff.payflows.io feature-flag surface
open_threads.why: unleash.payflows.io is 200 HTML (admin UI). ff.payflows.io is 200 HTML (likely proxy). Check for default credentials, unauthenticated /api/client/features (returns every flag + segment definition, which leaks hidden endpoints and new product codenames).

open_threads.name: storybook.payflows.io - Basic auth gated design system
open_threads.why: 401 Basic Realm='Login'. Low-severity but if credential-stuff succeeds, Storybook typically embeds every private component's props, mocked API responses, and sometimes mocked tokens. Useful recon feed for the Vue front-end.

open_threads.name: CDN-origin IP discovery for api.payflows.io / app.payflows.io
open_threads.why: front-end sits behind CloudFront. Pull passive DNS / CT history for direct ALB / EC2 IPs. Direct origin access bypasses WAF per Claude.md attack pattern.

open_threads.name: Cognito self-signup + luigi WS post-auth exploration
open_threads.why: The Cognito User Pool backing app.payflows.io (identity pool eu-west-1:d1d858d9-a60d-456e-9321-0745dacfac45 confirmed in bundle) likely allows self-signup. A valid-signature Cognito JWT would let us test whether the luigi public WS authorizer scopes conversation_id to the token's tenant/user. This requires the 'request a test account' reserved decision in Claude.md and is pending user approval.

pending_decisions: whether to request an authenticated test account before the auth surface pass - needed to escalate luigi WS beyond the info-disclosure finding and to attempt SCIM / Unleash authenticated checks

findings.summary: Public Luigi WS Lambda authorizer leaks Python exception strings ('badly formed hexadecimal UUID string', "'kid'", 'Public key not found in jwks.json') and the full pre-auth model to any unauthenticated client.
